caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object that resembles a mailbox mounted on a post. The object is composed of a rectangular box with a flat, unevenly weathered top. The box features a thin, horizontal slot near the top center and a larger, square front panel with a round hole in its lower portion. The wood grain and texture are visible throughout the object's surfaces, rendered in various shades of brown to suggest aged, untreated wood. The box is attached to a vertical wooden post, which extends downward and connects to a flat, pentagonal base. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional elements or objects present. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with the object positioned vertically in the middle of the image.
title: Mail Box
